title: Multi key Loudouts
description: You can have Multikey Loudouts for example: One for building, One for pvp
body:
# 🎮 MultiKey Loadouts

Tired of constantly changing your keybinds? **MultiKey Loadouts** lets you create and switch between multiple keybinding profiles instantly!

Whether you're fighting in PvP ⚔️, building massive structures 🏗️, exploring the world 🌍, or playing minigames 🎯, you can keep a separate keybind setup for every situation.


<details>
<summary>Please be Pacient.</summary>

I will get the 26.x version soon, and I'll try to make the mod as easy as possible for you.

</details>



## ✨ Features

✅ Create multiple keybind loadouts

✅ Switch between loadouts instantly

✅ Configure up to **4 dedicated loadout keys**

✅ Fully customizable in the settings menu

✅ No more manually changing keybinds

## 🔧 How It Works

1. Create your keybind loadouts.
2. Assign them to one of the four configurable switch keys.
3. Press the corresponding key to instantly activate that loadout.

```text
Loadout Key 1 → PvP ⚔️
Loadout Key 2 → Building 🏗️
Loadout Key 3 → Exploration 🌍
Loadout Key 4 → Minigames 🎯
```

## 📂 Example Setup

```yaml
Loadouts:
  PvP:
    Sprint: R
    Inventory: TAB

  Building:
    Inventory: E
    Hotbar Slot 9: R

  Exploration:
    Map: M
    Waypoints: V
```

## 🚀 Why Use MultiKey Loadouts?

Switching between activities often requires different keybinds. Instead of editing your controls every time, simply press a key and instantly load your preferred configuration.

```java
if (loadoutKeyPressed) {
    activateLoadout(selectedLoadout);
}
```

## 💡 Perfect For

⚔️ PvP Players

🏗️ Builders

🌍 Explorers

🎯 Minigame Players

🛠️ Modpack Users

Customize your controls once, save them as loadouts, and switch between them whenever you need them!
